note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with HS codes, ports and BOL numbers exist for Feb 2026, with shipments to China (Ningbo, Shekou) and South Africa (Durban) from Mundra, Vizag and Kolkata. The free ImportKey view shows only 5 of the 764 claimed rows, so the 764 figure is the site's counter, not independently verified row-by-row. Domestic supply evidence was not found in accessible sources — this is a gap in verification, not proof of absence; domestic_status is 'unknown', not 'none_found'. Note the four name variants (Unit 2, Unit-III) are treated as one legal entity; no separate shipment records were located per unit.
